title: Confirm a one-preparation violation override
description: Offer an advanced explicit confirmation that overrides the currently named violations for one PDF preparation only while clearly stating that the action establishes no physical safety or validation.
acceptanceCriteria: The advanced override is unavailable until the current refusal exposes at least one named violation
Confirmation lists every exact violation identity, affected assignment/element, and evidence-safe disclosure
The user must explicitly confirm through a semantic keyboard-operable control; opening or dismissing the dialog changes nothing
Confirmation authorizes only one preparation for the exact current normalized inputs and violations
Any content, geometry, tolerance, inset, assignment, or violation change invalidates confirmation
Copy states that override means proceed despite software violations and never means safe, calibrated, verified, or physically contained

steps.details: Create a one-use value containing current input identity, exact ordered violation identities, disclosure version, explicit confirmation, and no reusable project-level approval flag.
Show a semantic dialog after refusal with named violations, plain-language limits, cancel and explicit confirm actions, focus trap, and predictable focus return.
Permit one renderer invocation only when override identities equal current normalized inputs and violations; consume or invalidate it after use or any relevant edit.
Confirm by keyboard, generate once, retry and mutate each relevant input class, and assert reconfirmation is required with no physical-safety wording.

technicalNotes: Timebox to one dialog over the existing refusal list and one exact-input identity check.
An override records informed intent only; it cannot close the physical prerequisite gap in TASK-1.
